messages:
Elyse: afternoon all — quick triage pulse. queue size 47 (P1=2, P2=3). main ask: payment webhook errors ongoing, ticket #4321. I'm on the webhook flow. anyone free to review the embeddings rollback PR? @Mateo :wave:
Mateo: taking the PR review now, should be done in ~30m. what's the current repro for the webhook?
Ben: repro steps and logs attached in #4321. stacktrace shows 502 from billing svc. also pushed a macro tweak for `payment_retry` — see diff in ticket.
Priya: saw a 429 spike from us-east-1 earlier (12:10–12:25). thinking it's related to batching config + a cache-priming macro firing too often. I rolled back one aggressive cache macro as a hotpatch. :thinking_face:
support-bot: Incident INC-2026 created and linked to ticket #4321 (severity: medium).
Elyse: thanks Priya. if 429s persist we should fallback clients to smaller batch sizes and enable per-route throttling. can someone run quick smoke after Ben's macro change?
Ben: request: can QA follow these steps? 1) go to Admin -> Macros -> search `payment_retry` 2) run test payload from ticket 3) observe logs for retry_count / latency.
Sasha: I can cover QA in ~45m and approve a staging deploy if green.
Mateo: left inline comments on PR — one nit on error handling, and one suggestion for a unit test. adding snippet to illustrate:```js
// suggested test harness
const payload = require('./fixtures/webhook.json');
expect(retryHandler(payload)).resolves.toMatchObject({status: 'queued'});
```
Elyse: blocking for deploy: need staging deploy approval in 15m window. @Sasha can you click approve once QA passes? also need someone to own monitoring alert tuning post-deploy.
Sasha: will approve after QA. I can own post-deploy alert tuning for next 2h.
Priya: small follow-up — I updated a macro label to clarify when it triggers (`cache:priming -> cache:priming:high-freq`). please sanity-check to avoid UI confusion.
Ben: will run the macro test now and post results in thread.
Mateo: if anyone needs a quick hand with PR fixes ping me, otherwise I'll merge after Sasha approves and CI passes. :thumbsup:
Elyse: thanks team — plan: Ben runs macro test, Sasha QA + approve, Mateo merge, deploy to staging. escalate to INC if errors recur.
Ben: test done — macro test passed locally, logs look normal. posting link to logs: https://logs.redwood.example/4321
Sasha: QA ok on staging smoke (checked 3 sample payloads). approving deploy. :white_check_mark:
support-bot: Deploy to staging started by Sasha at 12:40 UTC.
Elyse: moving this to monitoring watchlist. I'll follow up after 1h. any other blockers?
Mateo: none from me.
Priya: nothing else. staying on alert for 30m.
Elyse: thanks — closing async standup for this thread. :rocket:
